thread: andrea: Quick heads up — I clicked the 'Model onboarding' card and it jumped to an anchor that doesn't exist anymore. Got a 404. samir: thanks. can you paste the URL the card links to? andrea: it's https://kb.redwood/internal/ml/onboard.md#start-checklist — looks like the heading was renamed last month. docbot: autolink-scan: discovered 1 broken anchor in /internal/ml/onboard.md (scan: s-2026-03-18-22). Alerting #docs. mike: I see — renaming happened in PR 0b1f2. Two easy options: re-add the old anchor (HTML tag) or update inbound refs. i'll open a micro-PR to restore anchor + add doc_owner frontmatter. tina: please include a short changelog line and add alt text check for images while you're in there. mike: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5201 — restores above the checklist header, and adds frontmatter: doc_owner: eng-platform. jen: i'll take a quick QA pass once it's merged. can someone grep dashboard cards for other references to #start-checklist? samir: on it. quick ripgrep found refs in dashboard/cards.yml and a legacy staff wiki page. filing a ticket to canonicalize and add a lint: INF-2522. mike: updated PR to include a unit test in docs-link-check that validates legacy anchors resolve (so the scanner won't immediately regress), and added a CHANGES.md entry. pr-bot: PR 5201 — CI: link-check & unit tests passed. awaiting approvals. tina: left two small nits in the PR: missing alt on the onboarding diagram and a grammar tweak. andrea, can you confirm alt text? andrea: Alt: "onboarding flow: invite → setup → trial → production". :thumbsup: tina: pushed fixes, will merge after one more approve. also drafting a non-blocking docs-ci job to warn for missing anchors before they break UX. samir: INF-2522 created: "Anchor-drift detection in docs CI — warn first, then fail after 2 weeks of warnings." Added sample ripgrep command to the ticket. docbot: INF-2522 ticket created by samir. Dev-rollout of anchor-warn job scheduled. mike: merged PR 5201. i'll watch the anchor-warn job tomorrow morning and follow up if more hits show up. andrea: thanks team. i've added a QA step to our onboarding checklist to click the dashboard card as part of smoke tests so we catch this earlier.
